description: Look up the status and full audit record for a previously executed settlement. Use this to check if a payment completed, to retrieve the tx hash for on-chain verification, or to pull the compliance record for reporting. Returns status (executed/held/failed/pending), tx hash, amounts, fee breakdown, oracle conditions at time of execution, ESG score, AI reasoning, and timestamp. The settlement ID is returned by settlement.execute.

settlementId.description: Settlement ID from the settlement_execute tool (format: dpx_...)

name: settlement.status
